integrity: The proof establishes the all-dimensional exact claim; an independent integer-lattice checker corroborates five rational cases. Computational tests are not a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact population uniform covariance for two-point equal-length clusters; does not handle arbitrary linear-coordinate changes, heterogeneous cluster distances, or finite-sample estimation. At t=1 the matching is unidentifiable. Complete bibliographic novelty cannot be guaranteed by search.
title: Covariance tomography of uniformly sampled paired-cluster Lipschitz potentials
